records.finding: Read the selection method and the explanations of Tables 1–3. These tables list reported variable stars and include lower-confidence single-sinusoidal cases; an exact TIC match is a prior variability report. All three were searched with separately returned positive-control TICs.

TIC 302959739 appears in Table 1 with a SOAR/Goodman spectrum dated 2022-02-19 and a lithium equivalent width of 377.6 ± 28.0 mÅ. Section IV.2 estimates an association age from group Gaia variability. The retrieved paper does not provide a target-specific 0.4377 d period or an individual variable-star designation; the population statistic is not treated as such a designation. The associated VizieR catalogue request failed, and no missing table is treated as empty.

The website describes processing about 95% of quality-passing TESS 2-minute light curves. All 16 targets have data pages; these memberships alone are not classifications as variables. Neighboring training-set objects shown on a target page cannot be attributed to the target.

Notice updated 2026-11-18 explains a security incident and lists IDIA and Harvard mirrors. This run used the working IDIA SIMBAD/VizieR endpoints. The notice dates Harvard ingestion to 2026-10-14 but provides no equivalent cutoff for IDIA; mirror freshness is not assumed.
